## Diagnostics

Please download diagnostics from **Settings → Devices & services → Miner → device → Download diagnostics** and attach the JSON file here.

Before uploading, check the file yourself. hass-miner diagnostics are designed not to include passwords, pool credentials or wallet/worker credentials. If you still see anything private, remove it and mention what field had to be removed.

## Notes

Describe anything unusual about the miner, firmware UI, API, errors, or behavior. Do not post passwords, private keys, pool credentials, or wallet addresses.
